model: Auto (copilot)

Review the current files and provide feedback on their content, structure, and oveall quality. Please identify any areas that may need improvement or clarification.

Use the copilot-instruction.md file as a guide for your review process.

Also use other best practices that you know of for reviewing files.

Do NOT examine other files in the repository, only the current files.

End the review with a question about what findings to implement.
